title: Templars, Lalibela and the Ark in Ethiopia

tellings.quote: I speculated that he tipped the Templars off that the Ark of the Covenant was in Ethiopia

plain: Author Graham Hancock tells Jesse Michels about an idea from his book The Sign and the Seal. He says he speculated that, during the Crusades, someone tied to Lalibela in Ethiopia tipped off the Knights Templar, a medieval order of Christian knights based at the Temple Mount in Jerusalem, that the Ark of the Covenant, the sacred chest described in the Bible, was in Ethiopia. If true, it would mean the Ark's location was known to the Templars.
